newsitem.title: USA: Wis. 98-99 budget approval seen later than usual.
newsitem.headline: Wis. 98-99 budget approval seen later than usual.

text.p: Wisconsin lawmakers often debate into the new fiscal biennium before adopting a state spending plan, but this year's talks could take them past mid-July, the assistant director of the non-partisan Wisconsin Legislative Fiscal Bureau said Thursday.
Wisconsin's Joint Finance Committee advanced a $37.2 billion all-funds spending plan June 9 for the fiscal biennium that began Tuesday.
The spending package went first to the majority Democrat Wisconsin Senate, which has not yet acted on it, Assistant Director Terry Rhodes said.

"It is hard to say what is typical," Rhodes said. "They almost always cross over into the next fiscal year, but the legislature usually concludes by early to mid-July. It will probably be somewhat later than that."
